name: Broadcast-realism aspect + palette
tagline: For "caught on TV" trend recreations, 1:1 square reads more real than strict 9:16 — real broadcast cameras shoot 16:9, so a tall portrait crop triggers the AI-detector eye. Plus a cross-cutting default toward natural / muted color over neon.
description: How to choose aspect ratio and color grade for trend-recreation content whose premise is 'this was caught on a real broadcast camera' (sports cam, news cam, audience cam, talk-show cam). Square 1:1 splits the difference between TV-native 16:9 and feed-native 9:16 and reads as a believable capture; strict portrait reads as AI-generated. Also codifies a general palette default: reach for natural / muted / film grades, not magenta-cyan neon.
